home.heroTitle: Stay close to everything in Cebu.
home.heroLede: Clean rooms, easy parking, and a simple way to book your stay.
home.introTitle: A quiet stay with a Japanese spirit
home.introLede: Welcome to Mori International Hotel — where traditional Japanese calm meets contemporary comfort.
home.introP1: Our property features a pioneering modular design with 19 cozy rooms of about 18 square meters, each with inverter air conditioning, 24-hour hot and cold showers, complimentary drinking water, unlimited Wi-Fi, and ample parking.
home.introP2: Just 6 kilometers from the airport and 4 kilometers from Cebu City’s major seaports, you are close to restaurants, shops, and everyday conveniences — without losing the sense of rest.
home.introNote: Book ahead and your room is held as a reservation. Arriving within the minimum lead time? It stays a standard booking.

legal.privacyLede: Last updated 8 September 2026. This notice is for guests using this website and Google guest accounts.
legal.termsLede: Last updated 7 September 2026. These terms apply to bookings and guest accounts on this website.

privacy.whoP1Before: Mori International Hotel, AS Fortuna, Mandaue City, Cebu, is the personal information controller for guest data collected on this site. Contact us at
privacy.whoP2: This policy follows the Philippines Data Privacy Act of 2012 (Republic Act No. 10173) and National Privacy Commission guidance: a privacy notice is not the same as consent. We show this notice, then ask you to tick a box before we create a guest account.
privacy.dataLi1: From Google sign-in: verified email address, name, and a Google account identifier.
privacy.dataLi2: From your booking: guest names, phone number, stay dates and times, room types, guest counts, special-offer or discount requests, and messages you send us.
privacy.dataLi3: From your stay: booking status, payments or receipts you upload (not full card numbers), and reviews you choose to publish.
privacy.dataP: We do not ask for government IDs online. Senior Citizen and PWD discounts are applied by hotel staff at the front desk upon verification.
privacy.whyIntro: We process this data only for hotel operations:
privacy.whyLi1: Create and sign you into a guest-level account linked to Google.
privacy.whyLi2: Receive, confirm, and manage bookings and reservations.
privacy.whyLi3: Contact you about your stay (including phone verification before check-in).
privacy.whyLi4: Apply rates, stay fees, and offers that match your request.
privacy.whyLi5: Keep records the hotel needs for accounting, security, and complaints.
privacy.whyP: Account creation uses your consent (the checkbox on the guest agreement). Completing a booking also relies on the contract to provide your stay. We do not sell your personal data. We do not use this form for marketing newsletters.
privacy.seeLi1: Hotel staff who need it to run the front desk, rooms, and bookings.
privacy.seeLi2: Google, only as the sign-in provider when you choose Continue with Google.
privacy.seeLi3: When you use Mori Assistant on this site, your question and public hotel facts may be sent to Google Gemini and/or Groq to generate a reply. We do not look up your reservation in chat.
privacy.seeLi4: Service providers that host this website or deliver email, under our instructions.
privacy.seeP: Staff Google logins are separate from guest accounts and do not use this guest consent screen.
privacy.keepP: We keep guest account and booking records for as long as the account is active and for a reasonable period afterward so we can answer stay questions, complete accounting, and meet legal duties. You may ask us to close the account or correct details using the contact information above.
privacy.rightsP1: Under the Data Privacy Act you may request to be informed, access your data, correct it, withdraw consent where consent is the basis we used, or object to processing that is not required to complete a stay you already requested. To use these rights, email the hotel. You may also contact the National Privacy Commission if you have a privacy complaint.
privacy.rightsP2: You can stop using the guest account by logging out. Cancel on the agreement screen if you do not want an account created.
privacy.securityP: We store account passwords with ASP.NET Identity hashing. Google guest accounts keep a fixed Google email and may also set a hotel password for email or username sign-in. Booking forms use anti-forgery tokens. We do not store raw credit-card numbers on this site.
privacy.relatedBefore: Stay rules, rates, and cancellation are in the
privacy.cookiesP1: We use a short cookie notice so you can choose Accept all or Necessary only. Those two choices are equal: rejecting non-essential cookies does not block booking or Google sign-in.
privacy.cookiesIntro: Necessary cookies and similar storage (always on) keep the site working:
privacy.cookiesLi1: Sign-in and security cookies (your session and anti-forgery tokens).
privacy.cookiesLi3: Your cookie choice, so we do not ask on every page.
privacy.cookiesP2: A stay draft (dates and rooms you started) is stored only if you choose Accept all. Necessary only does not save that short booking information. We do not currently load marketing or analytics cookies. You can change this anytime from Cookies in the footer.

terms.whoBefore: Mori International Hotel (“we”, “the hotel”) operates this site for guests booking a stay at our property in Mandaue City, Cebu. By creating a guest account, submitting a booking request, or using this site, you agree to these terms and to our
terms.accountsP1: Guest accounts are created with Google sign-in. The account is for guests only — it is not a staff login and does not grant access to hotel operations tools. You must keep your Google account secure. You may log out at any time from the profile menu.
terms.accountsP2: You agree to give accurate stay details (name, contact information, dates, and guest counts) and not to misuse booking tools or other guests’ information. Fraudulent or abusive activity may lead to account or booking restrictions.
terms.bookingsP1: A request on this site is sent to the hotel for review. We may confirm, request more information, or decline a stay if rooms are unavailable or details cannot be verified. Reception may call the number you provide before check-in.
terms.bookingsP2: Requests made well ahead of arrival may be treated as a reservation. Requests closer to arrival (within the site’s minimum lead time) are treated as a booking. Either way, the stay is not guaranteed until the hotel confirms it.
terms.stayP: Our priority is a calm, comfortable stay. From arrival through checkout, guests are asked to respect house policies, other guests, and hotel staff.
terms.stayLi1: Standard check-in is 14:00 (Manila time). Early check-in at 11:30 may be offered for a fee when available.
terms.stayLi2: Standard check-out is 12:00. Late checkout may be offered by the hour, up to the hotel’s posted limit, for a fee.
terms.stayLi3: Each room includes two guests. Extra persons may be charged per night, subject to room capacity.
terms.stayLi4: Senior Citizen and PWD discounts (20% off the stay) are applied by hotel staff at the front desk upon verification of valid ID. They cannot be combined with an active special offer or walk-in promo.
terms.ratesP: Nightly rates and special offers shown on this site apply only while they are active and only for the room types listed. Some offers require cash on arrival. The booking summary before you submit is the amount we will record for the stay, plus any stay fees you select (early check-in, late checkout, extra person).
terms.cancelP: Cancellation and prepayment rules can vary by booking and offer. If you need to change or cancel, contact the hotel using the details on our Contact section. We will confirm any charges or refunds in writing when we can.
terms.dataBefore: How we collect and use your information is explained in the
terms.dataAfter: . Creating a guest account requires your consent to process personal data for that account, bookings, and stay-related contact.
